vol_edge_probe — 3D probe op

• Data kinds: voxel → table

• Call: import volprobe; volprobe.vol_edge_probe(vol, p0, p1, sigma=1.0, threshold=0.1, spacing=None, polarity='all') (or ops3d.get("vol_edge_probe"))

Usage

Sub-sample edges along the probe `p0 -> p1`.
